name: JE_HU_BALANCES_REPORT
description:
JE_HU_BALANCES_REPORT contains
                                         information used for the Hungarian
                                         Asset Movement Schedule, the Hungarian
                                         Accumulated Depreciation Movement
                                         Schedule, and the Hungarian
                                         Depreciation Analysis Report. Oracle
                                         Assets never permanently stores data in
                                         this table. When you submit a balances
                                         report, Oracle Assets deletes any data
                                         in this table before running the report.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_CCID
columns.description:
Accounting Flexfield identifier
                                               for depreciation expense account
                                               for the asset

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_CCID
columns.description:
Accounting Flexfield identifier
                                               for adjustment account for the
                                               asset

columns.name: CATEGORY_BOOKS_ACCOUNT
columns.description:
Account being adjusted, or
                                               depreciation reserve account

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description:
Transaction or balance this row
                                               describes

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description:
Depreciation, adjustment, cost,
                                               or reserve balance amount

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
